title: Product Photography for Miami Brands
metaTitle: Product Photography for Miami Brands | TDM
metaDescription: Product shoots for Miami e-commerce brands: catalog, lifestyle and detail images shot in the US by our team, retouched and sized for your store, Amazon and ads.
lead: TDM (The Digital Marketing Services) photographs products for Miami brands that sell through their own store, on marketplaces such as Amazon, or through paid social. The work covers art direction, shooting, retouching and delivery in every crop each channel needs. Our US-based team photographs your products in the United States, on location or in a setup suited to the range, and a member of the team is based in Miami. The selected images are then retouched at our operations office in Lahore and delivered to you digitally.

sections.heading: What Miami sells, and why the photos carry the sale
paragraphs: A great deal of what Miami brands make is bought on appearance. Swimwear and resort wear, much of it tied to the designers who show during Swim Week. Beauty, skincare and fragrance. Jewellery and accessories. Rum, coffee, sauces and other food products rooted in the city's Cuban, Caribbean and Latin American kitchens. Furniture and decor from the showrooms around the Design District. A customer in Chicago or Madrid cannot pick any of it up. The image has to stand in for holding the product.
Many of these businesses also wholesale. Buyers for boutiques, hotels and distributors in Latin America expect a clean, consistent catalog, and a line sheet with mismatched phone photos costs orders.

sections.heading: How a product shoot with TDM works
paragraphs: We map your catalog and channels and define a set list: catalog angles, lifestyle scenes and detail shots per product. You approve that list and the art direction, and our US-based team then photographs the range in the United States with lighting and styling kept consistent. The selects go to our retouchers at the operations office in Lahore and come back to you for review. After your notes are applied, finals are exported in every crop and resolution and delivered named and organised.

Because the photography happens in this country, the plan can follow the product. Swimwear can be shot on a model near the water, a rum or a hot sauce beside the food it belongs with, and a sofa in the showroom where it already stands. Fragile, perishable and oversized items are discussed at the briefing so the right setup is ready on the day.
bullets: Studio catalog images on white or coloured backgrounds, consistent across the whole range.
Styled lifestyle scenes with props and surfaces that suit a warm-weather, coastal brand, indoors or outside.
Macro detail shots of fabric, stitching, labels, finishes and mechanisms.
Sets that meet Amazon and other marketplace requirements for background, framing and resolution.
Colour-accurate retouching, because misleading images come back as returns.
Files sized for your store, marketplace listings, ads and social templates.

sections.heading: Catalog set or location campaign
paragraphs: Most Miami sellers need two kinds of image, and they are planned differently. Catalog photography is about repetition: the same angle, light and crop for every item, so that a collection page looks like one brand. Campaign photography is about context: swimwear on a person, a dish as it leaves the kitchen, a chair in a furnished room. Often the answer is both: a consistent catalog set for the store and marketplaces, and a shorter location session for the images that lead your ads.

sections.heading: What to check before commissioning a shoot
paragraphs: Agree the number of images per product and the angles before anything is photographed. Confirm that retouching and all export sizes are included. Ask how colour accuracy is checked, especially for fabrics and cosmetics. And ask what happens to your samples afterwards: returned, kept for a later shoot, or disposed of.

presence: A member of our team is based in Miami and can help you plan the shot list and the session. The photography is done in the United States by our US-based team and the retouching at our operations office in Lahore, with approvals handled online.

faqs.a: In the United States, by TDM's own US-based team, and a member of that team is based in Miami. Depending on the brief, the session takes place on location, at your premises or in a setup arranged for the range. The images are then retouched at our operations office in Lahore.

faqs.q: What do I need to prepare before the session?
faqs.a: One clean sample of each product and variant to be photographed, plus any packaging, props or swatches that must appear. We agree the set list and art direction with you beforehand, and settle at the briefing how the items get to our team for the session.

faqs.q: How much does product photography cost?
faqs.a: It depends on the number of products, the images per product and how much styling the lifestyle scenes need. We quote after a free consultation and a look at your catalog.

faqs.q: Will the images meet Amazon requirements?
faqs.a: Yes, when that is part of the brief. We shoot and export main and secondary images to marketplace specifications for background, framing and resolution, alongside the versions for your own store and ads.

faqs.q: How long does a product shoot take for a Miami brand?
faqs.a: It depends on the size of the catalog, the number of images per product and how many lifestyle scenes are involved. The schedule for the session, retouching and review is agreed in the plan, so tell us about any launch date at the start.
